name: Fiend

bonuses.name: Soporific Musk
bonuses.text: Enemy units Engaged with a Fiend suffer a +2 DN penalty to all Tests. Environmentally sealed armour or vehicles do not negate the effect.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Fiend must pass a DN 4 Fear Test.

note: Barbed Tail prints 'Inflict (Poison 6)', stored Inflict (Poisoned 6) per catalogue spelling.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
